items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects four auxiliary identifications for the isomorphism pseudo torsor of a pair of objects over an algebraic space (author lemma at source lines 1391-1425, label lemma-isom-pseudo-torsor-aut-over-space); the author's own proof at source lines 1427-1433 follows it immediately and is its proof, deriving the four items from the definition, from the exact sequence, by unwinding definitions and by etale localization (proof lines 1427-1432). The four justifications are short and each rests on a single quoted device; this card is registered at the lower level and is the last item of this chapter that clears this lane's bar for a proof of its own. H2.
